family_reports.body: Jordan Dalgleish is a snake who will lie, cheat, & manipulate anyone and she is the last person who should be representing any child. Ever.
The family court system has cost me precious time with my children, furthered our traumatic experiences, favors reunification over safety, and continues to horrify me

The family court system wrongfully removed my child at Jordan Dalgleish’s suggestion after accepting a fraudulent document as fact, DHS involvement and still I am missing out on important things in my child’s life, my child is extremely depressed.

The court system has allowed lies told by one side without evidence to be the sole decision in allowing one of my children to be taken. It has caused significant damage to my relationship with my child and the relationship with the child’s siblings.
Family court is a circus and for all of the lip service to “children’s best interest”, my kids are BY FAR, worse off today because of it.
They tore us apart, they are the reason I stayed in the abuse until he finally tried to kill me because I knew what would happen to us in okmulgee county
